text.p: OFFICIAL NOTICE OF SALE
TOWNSHIP OF HAMBURG
COUNTY OF LIVINGSTON, STATE OF MICHIGAN
WASTEWATER TREATMENT PLANT
REVENUE BONDS, SERIES 1997
SEALED BIDS: Sealed bids for the purchase of the above-
designated bonds (the Bod by the Township of
Hamburg, Livingston County, Michigan (the Township"), will
received by the undersigned at the Township Hall, 10405 Merr Road, Hamburg, Michigan 48139, until 4:00 o'clock p.m., East Time, on
at which time and place the bids will be opened and read publicly.

Sealed bids also will be received until the same date and t by an agent of the undersigned at the offices of the Bendzin Co., Municipal Finance Advisors, One Kennedy Square, Griswold, Suite 2130, Detroit, Michigan 48226, where they wi opened and read publicly. Bids opened at Detroit will be op and read first. Bidders may choose either location to prese bids, but not both locations.
The award of the Bonds will be made (or all bids will be rejected) at a meeting of the Township Board beginning not l than 5:30 p.m., Eastern Time, on the day of the sale.

With respect to partial redemptions, any portion of a Bon outstanding in a denomination larger than the minimum author denomination may be redeemed provided such portion and the a not being redeemed each constitutes an authorized denominati If less than the entire principal amount of a Bond is called redemption, upon surrender of the Bond to the Bond Registrar Bond Registrar shall authenticate and deliver to the registe owner a new Bond in the principal amount of the principal po not being redeemed.

Notice of redemption shall be sent to the registered holder each Bond being redeemed by first class United States mail a least 30 days before the date fixed for redemption, which no shall fix the date of record with respect to the redemption. defect in any notice of redemption shall not affect the vali of the redemption proceedings. Bonds so called for redempti shall not bear interest after the date fixed for redemption provided funds or Sufficient Government Obligations then are deposit with the Bond Registrar to redeem such Bonds.

INTEREST RATE AND BIDDING DETAILS: The Bonds shall bear interest at a rate or rates not exceeding 8.00% per annum, t fixed by the bids for the Bonds, expressed in multiples of 1 1/20 of 1%, or both. The interest on any one Bond shall be one rate only, and all Bonds maturing in any one year must b the same interest rate. No Bond may bear interest at a rate is more than five (5) percentage points above the rate borne any other Bond. No proposal for the purchase of less than a the Bonds, or at a price that is less than 98.5% of par, wil considered.

BOOK-ENTRY-ONLY: The Bonds will be issued in book-entry on form as one fully registered bond per maturity and will be registered in the name of Cede & Co., as bondholder and nomi for The Depository Trust Company ("DTC"), New York, New York DTC will act as securities depository for the Bonds. Purcha the Bonds will be made in book-entry-only form, in

denomination of $5,000 or any multiple thereof. Purcha not receive certificates representing their interest in Bond purchased. The book-entry-only system is described further the Preliminary Official Statement for the
Bonds.
BOND REGISTRAR AND DATE OF RECORD: Old Kent Bank, Grand Rap Michigan, has been selected as Bond Registrar. The Bond

Registrar will keep records of the registered owners of the Bonds, serve as transfer agent, authenticate the original an re-issued Bonds and pay interest by check or draft to the registered owners of the Bonds as shown on the records of th Bond Registrar on the applicable date of record. The date o record for each interest payment will be the 15th day of the month before such payment is due. Principal of the Bonds wi paid at maturity upon presentation and surrender thereof to Bond Registrar.

PURPOSE AND SECURITY: The Bonds are being issued pursuant t No. 94, Public Acts of Michigan, 1933, as amended ("Act 94") defray part of the cost of improving the Township's sanitar sewer system (the "System") by acquiring, constructing and equipping a wastewater treatment plant to serve the Township The Bonds and other bonds issued by the Township on a parity basis with the Bonds are payable from the revenues of the Sy after provision is made for reasonable and necessary expense operation, maintenance and administration of the System (the Net Revenues"). The Township has created a first lien (ma statutory lien by Act 94) upon the Net Revenues of the Syste secure payment of the principal of and interest on the Bonds such additional parity indebtedness.

Reference is made to the Township Ordinance authorizing the Bonds for a complete statement of the revenues from which an conditions under which the Bonds are payable, a statement of conditions under which additional bonds of equal standing as the Net Revenues of the System may be issued and the covenan and conditions pursuant to which the Bonds are issued.
GOOD FAITH: A certified or cashier's check drawn upon an

incorporated bank or trust company or a Financial Surety Bon the amount of $52,250.00 and payable to the order of the Treasurer of the Township must accompany each bid as a guara of good faith on the part of the bidder, to be forfeited as liquidated damages if such bid is accepted and the bidder fa to take up and pay for the Bonds. If a check is used, it mu accompany the bid. If a Financial Surety Bond is used, it m be from an insurance company licensed to issue such a bond i Michigan, and such bond must be submitted to the Township or financial advisor, Bendzinski & Co., Municipal Finance Advis prior to the opening of bids. The Financial Surety Bond mus identify each bidder whose good faith deposit is guaranteed such bond. If the Bonds are awarded to a bidder using a

Financial Surety Bond, then that purchaser is required to su its good faith deposit to the Township or its financial advi in the form of a cashier's check or by wire transfer (in accordance with instructions from the Township or its financ advisor) not later than 12:00 noon, Eastern ime, on the nex business day following the award. If such good faith deposi

not received by that time, the Financial Surety Bond ma upon by the Township to satisfy the good faith depo requirement. If the purchaser fails to honor its accepted b the good faith deposit will be retained by the Township. No interest will be allowed on good faith checks. Checks of unsuccessful bidders will be returned to the bidder's representative or by overnight delivery service. The good f check of the successful bidder will be cashed, and the proce will be applied to the purchase price of the Bonds. Payment the balance of the purchase price shall be made at closing. AWARD OF THE BONDS: The Bonds will be awarded to the bidde whose bid produces the lowest interest cost computed determining, at the rate or rates specified in the bid, the dollar value of all interest on the Bonds from August 1, 199 their maturity and deducting any premium and adding any disc LEGAL OPINION: Bids shall be conditioned upon the approvin opinion of bond counsel, Dykema Gossett PLLC, Lansing, Michi a copy of which will be printed on the back of each Bond and original of which will be furnished without expense to the purchaser of the Bonds at the delivery thereof. The fees of counsel for services in connection with its opinion are expe to be paid from Bond proceeds. Except to the extent necessa issue its opinion, bond counsel has not been requested to ex or review, and has not examined or reviewed, any financial documents, statements or materials that have been or may be furnished in connection with the authorization, issuance or marketing of the Bonds and, accordingly, will not express an opinion with respect to the accuracy or completeness of any financial documents, statements or materials.
TAX MATTERS: In the opinion of Bond Counsel, assumin

compliance with certain covenants by the Township, interest the Bonds is excluded from gross income for federal income t purposes, as described in bond counsel's opinion, and the Bo and interest thereon are exempt from all taxation in the Sta Michigan except inheritance and estate taxes and taxes on ga realized from the same, payment or other disposition thereof The successful bidder will be required to furnish, prior to delivery of the
Bonds, a certifi ptable to Bond Counsel as to the "issue price" of the Bonds within the meani
of Section 1273 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as ame
QUALIFIED TAX-EXEMPT OBLIGATIONS: The Township has designa the Bonds as "qualified tax-exempt obligations" for purposes deduction of interest by financial institutions.

CUSIP NUMBERS: It is anticipated that CUSIP numbers will b printed on the Bonds, but neither the failure to print such numbers nor any improperly printed number shall be cause for purchaser to refuse to accept delivery. All expenses for

printing CUSIP numbers on the Bonds will be paid by the Town except that the CUSIP Service Bureau charge for assignment o such numbers shall be the responsibility of and paid for by purchaser of the Bonds.
DELIVERY OF BONDS: The successful bidder must accept deliv of the Bonds no later than July 28, 1997. The Township will furnish Bonds ready for execution at its expense. Bonds wil
delivered without expense to the purchaser through DTC York, New York. The usual closing documents, including a
certificate that no litigation is pending affecting the Bond will be delivered at the time of delivery of the Bonds.

Payment for the Bonds shall be made in immediately availabl funds. Accrued interest to the date of delivery of the Bond shall be paid by the purchaser at the time of delivery. Unl the purchaser of the Bonds furnishes the Bond Registrar with list of names and denominations in which it wants to have th Bonds issued at least ten business days before delivery of t Bonds, the Bonds will be delivered in the form of one Bond f each maturity, registered in the name of the purchaser.
OFFICIAL STATEMENT: Bendzinski & Co., Municipal Finan

Advisors, financial advisors to the Township, will provide t winning bidder with 150 final Official Statements within 7 business days from the date of sale to permit the purchaser comply with Securities and Exchange Commission Rule 15c2-12. Additional copies of the Statement will be

Bendzinski & Co., Municipal Finance Advisors upon request an agreement by the purchaser to pay the cost of additional cop Requests for additional copies should be made to Bendzinski Co., Municipal Finance Advisors, within 24 hours of the date sale.

CONTINUING DISCLOSURE: As more fully described in the Offi Statement, the Township has agreed in the Continuing Disclos Undertaking of the Township, to provide or cause to be provi in accordance with the requirements of Rule 15c2-12 promulga by the Securities and Exchange Commission, on or prior to th 180th day after the end of the Township's fiscal year, (i) certain annual financial information and operating dat including audited financial statements for the preceding fis year, generally consistent with the information contained or cross-referenced in the Official Statement relating to the B (ii) timely notice of the occurrence of certain material eve with respect to the Bonds, and (iii) timely notice of a fail by the Township to provide the required annual finan information on or before the date specified in (i) above.
